context.purpose: Preserve active-user eligibility while tolerating records without an active field.
context.requirement: Only users explicitly marked active may be returned. Missing active means inactive and must not grant eligibility.
head_file_lines: return [user for user in users if user.get("active", True)]
context.caller_context: The notification worker sends a message to every record returned by eligible_users. Records without active are imported but must not receive messages.
